title: Order Sales Tax Standing After Lines Cancelled Before Dispatch
content:
When a line of an Online Orders order is cancelled before dispatch, the sales tax charged at placement no longer describes what the customer was charged. For a Returns & Exchanges return on such an order, the tax figure from which returned lines take their share is the order's tax standing at dispatch, as below.

## Tax figure shared out among returned lines

| A line of the order was cancelled before dispatch | How the order was captured | Tax figure |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Entirely on the card or wallet | The amount the card capture carried beyond the merchandise that shipped and the shipping fee: the card captures on the order, less the merchandise that shipped, less the shipping fee |
| Yes | Partly on stored value (any capture on a tender other than the card or wallet) | The sales tax charged at placement times the merchandise that shipped, divided by the net merchandise at placement |
| No | Any | The sales tax charged at placement |

- **Merchandise that shipped:** the net merchandise at placement (merchandise subtotal less discount total) less the amounts of the lines cancelled before dispatch.
- **Card captures:** the payment captures on the order made on the card or wallet tender; any capture on a gift card, Return Store Credit, Bonus Gift Card, Goodwill Credit or Rewards Note is a capture on stored value.
- The cancellation, the captures, the shipping fee and the placement figures are read from the Online Orders records of the order.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

An order was placed with net merchandise of 200.00, sales tax of 16.00 and a shipping fee of 8.00. A 50.00 line was cancelled before dispatch, so the merchandise that shipped is 150.00.

- Captured entirely on the card, for 170.00: the tax figure is 170.00 less 150.00 less 8.00, that is 12.00.
- Captured 120.00 on the card and 50.00 on a gift card: the tax figure is 16.00 times 150.00 divided by 200.00, that is 12.00.
- The same order with no cancellation: the tax figure is the 16.00 charged at placement.
